_note: How county governments may regulate land use in unincorporated areas, state by state, from a survey of each state's law on 2026-10-23 (one research reading per state; a second for any state a rule depends on). docs/county_zoning_authority.md explains the codes and the table. county_zoning_power: general (every county zones), optional (counties may zone but need not), limited (no general power; only named counties or subjects), none, no_county_land_use. zoning_transition marks the states where config/county_record_score.json may list a county moving from no zoning to zoning: counties may stay unzoned, the county is the body that zones unincorporated land, and no county siting permit for wind or solar exists outside zoning.
